# FormZalo

> FormZalo is an online CV (resume) builder with an Auto Form Filler for job applications. Free CV builder with no login, PDF/DOCX download, a free watermarked download, and paid single-use or yearly plans. Currently in trial mode: no real payments are taken yet.

## Key facts
- A free CV builder: creating, editing, saving and choosing templates are all free, with no login needed.
- Plain and designed CV templates.
- Download as PDF or DOCX (Word).
- Free watermarked download, so you can see exactly what you get before paying.
- Auto Form Filler: fills job application forms from your CV. A form-fill credit is used only when a fill succeeds, and is refunded if the fill fails.
- Dashboard: CVs made, CVs in progress, remaining balance, form fills used and companies applied to.

## Languages
- The tool's interface is available in English, Hindi, Japanese, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and French.
- Localised landing pages (so local search can find the tool) also exist in German, Portuguese, Polish, Italian and Russian. Those pages say so plainly: the tool itself runs in the interface languages above.

## Plans (launch offer; future plans may change, purchased package terms stay as bought)
- Free: create, edit, save, choose templates; watermarked PDF/DOCX download.
- Single Use: ₹20 one-time — one clean CV download OR one form fill.
- Career Starter: ₹1,000/year (≈ ₹83/month) — 2 profiles, 100 CV generations, 100 form fills (up to 100 companies within those fills). Same usage at ₹20 each = ₹4,000, so it saves ₹3,000 (75%).
- Global Single Use: $1 one-time — one clean CV download OR one form fill (form-fill credit used only on success).
- Global Pro: $29/year (≈ $2.42/month) — 300 CV generations, 300 form fills. 300 fills at $1 = $300, so it saves $271 (≈ 90%).
- No monthly plan.

## Support
- Email: team@formzalo.com. Requests are reviewed within 2 working days. (Email only.)

## Refunds
- ₹20 single use: full refund if the download fails because of a technical error on our side.
- Yearly plans: full refund within 7 days of purchase if unused; no refund once credits are used.

## Privacy
- The CV you type is saved in your browser's local storage on your device. For a clean (paid) download, CV content is sent to the server only to create the file; order records keep a hash of the CV, not its text.
